description:
Our kernel, trial 4's settings, and one thing changed: truncated credit instead of exact sensitivity. This exists to read the run beside it.
Upstream scored 324.90 on these settings where our kernel scored 1034.13, and two things could account for that at once. Upstream stops the gradient at the incoming carry, which is our tbptt and not our rtrl, and these settings were tuned under rtrl. It also normalises in environment wrappers whose statistics restart at every evaluation. This run holds the second fixed and changes only the first, so the pair separates them: near 325 says the gap is the credit and the implementations agree; near 1034 says the gap is ours to explain.
name: ablate-tbptt
